title: Affine-base restriction maps for projective spectra of a graded algebra sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $\mathcal A=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}\mathcal A_n$ a graded $\mathcal O_X$-algebra whose homogeneous components are quasi-coherent, as in [def-nagata-relative-proj]. For every affine open $U\subseteq X$ put $P_U=\operatorname{Proj}(\Gamma(U,\mathcal A))$ [def-nagata-affine-proj], with $p_U:P_U\to U$ induced by $\mathcal O_X(U)\to\Gamma(U,\mathcal A)_0$. For affine opens $V\subseteq U$, the graded restriction homomorphism induces a canonical morphism $r^U_V:P_V\to P_U$ over $U$. This morphism identifies $P_V$ with the open subscheme $p_U^{-1}(V)$ over $V$. It is the identity when $V=U$ and satisfies $r^U_W=r^U_V\circ r^V_W$ whenever $W\subseteq V\subseteq U$ are affine opens.
